description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C4 (HMO-house in multiple occupation) and single storey rear extension, rear dormer with front rooflights, involving associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location and Block Plans E00 Dated 26 January 2026;Existing Floor Plans E01 Dated 26 January 2026;Existing Elevations E02 Dated 26 January 2026;Existing Elevations E03 Dated 26 January 2026;Existing Sections E04 Dated 26 January 2026;Location and Block Plans P00 Dated 24 February 2026;Proposed Floor Plans P01 Dated 24 February 2026;Proposed Elevations P02 Dated 24 February 2026;Proposed Elevations P03 Dated 24 February 2026;Proposed Sections P04 Dated 24 February 2026;Proposed Cycle Storage Details P05 Dated 24 February 2026;Proposed Refuse and Recycling Storage Details P06 Dated 24 February 2026;SuDS Pro Forma;Highway Safety Impact Form; Flood Risk Assessment ref: LE2026160FRA Rev01 dated February 2026.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than six residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Prior to first occupation of the HMO, Cycle parking, shall be provided as indicated on drawing "Proposed Drawings Floor Plan P01 dated 02 April 2026", in accordance with the following requirements:o Provision of a minimum of FIVE long stay cycle parking spaces and TWO short stay cycle spaces;o in an accessible location;o long stay cycle parking spaces secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob;o fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof.Reason: To ensure the provision of accessible, secure, and adequate cycle parking facilities and to safeguard the character and appearance of the area.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the occupiers of adjoining premises; protect the general environment; prevent any obstruction to pedestrian movement and to ensure that there are adequate facilities for the storage and recycling of recoverable materials.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

Prior to first occupation of the development, a Verification Report demonstrating that the approved flood risk mitigation measures have been fully implemented shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.The Verification Report shall include:a) As built drawings of the flood compensation storage, including finished level information where appropriate;b) Photographic evidence of the completed flood compensation storage;c) Any relevant certificates from manufacturers or suppliers of the approved flood risk mitigation features; andd) A confirmation statement confirming compliance with the approved details, signed by the site manager or other suitably qualified person.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of surface water, minimise the risk of flooding to the site and surrounding area, and ensure the long-term functionality of the approved flood risk mitigation measures, in accordance with Policies CP28 and DMD 59-62 of the Enfield Local Plan, Policies SI12 and SI13 of the London Plan, and the National Planning Policy Framework.
